author: Nicolas Limare
description: Machine-readable schema for the Lmapping roadmap notation. A card carries two orthogonal signals: STATUS (its colour) and PHASE (its name + column position). A parser resolves a board deterministically by matching each card's fill/border against legend_hex and reading connectors as typed arrows.

status.carrier: card fill colour + a stronger same-hue border
status.note: A card's colour means the same thing anywhere on the board.

phase.column_header: a target time period (e.g. a month)

status_cycle.name: Demand
status_cycle.meaning: A request has been raised but not yet adopted onto the roadmap.

status_cycle.name: Intend
status_cycle.meaning: Adopted as an intention; being shaped, not yet committed.

status_cycle.name: Commit
status_cycle.meaning: Committed to a target period. Committed does NOT mean work has started.

status_cycle.name: Solution
status_cycle.meaning: Work begins here: the solution is being defined. Always the first active phase.

status_cycle.name: Specification
status_cycle.meaning: The first release is being specified. Handover to delivery happens at the end of this phase.

status_cycle.name: Development
status_cycle.meaning: In build (the delivery zone). This is the colour a card shows while 'active' in delivery.

blocked.note: A hard stop. Solid red, distinct from every status colour.

attention.note: Flags a card needing attention while KEEPING its underlying status. Explicitly NOT Blocked.

staging.note: A ghosted, faded intermediate step inside a chain.

corner_chip.note: A small tag in a card corner: dependency marker or track membership.

cartouche.shape: a box drawn around several cards
cartouche.means: the enclosed cards form ONE release; the release is the union of their subjects

arrows.two_ends_one_arrow: A summarised link (kick-start to rollout) shown in the published/collapsed view.
arrows.inter_track_dependency: A dependency from a card in one track to a card in another.
arrows.chain_progression: A step-to-step link along an expanded milestone chain.

encoding_contract.read: For each card, read fill, border, and fill-opacity; match fill against legend_hex to resolve status; read the column header for the phase's target period; read connectors as typed arrows.
encoding_contract.matching: Match on the nearest legend_hex colour; a fill-opacity near 0.2 marks staging; a solid #ff2e00 fill marks Blocked; an #ff8a00 fill or a thick red border marks Attention over the resolved status.

skills.read_skill: Turns a board into structured data (cards, statuses, phases, cartouches, arrows).
skills.write_skill: Applies updates and changes back onto the board in valid notation.
